message: Vector Rebel 3.2.62: SCBA Pass passes all 11, Missing fails all 11 with a comment, Issue expands 11 default Pass questions with a comment.
releaseNotes: SCBA airpacks default to Pass / Present / Working: one choice maps to all 11 verified native SCBA template 113271 questions. Missing marks all 11 checks as proposed Failed with a required comment only. Fail / Issue expands 11 individually editable checks, defaulting to proposed Pass, with a required comment. Specific answers are transferred into the official Vector form when fully reviewed, while unanswered checks are left for manual completion. Live Vector failure details modal was inspected on Voyager: choosing Failed opens a required Failure Notes field and an item selection. Rebel now fills that native field from the exception comment and chooses the exact failed SCBA item. The inspector reviews and submits the final native dialog. No inspection is auto-submitted.
